title: Eleonora Srugo Shows $25M Luxury Condo at Madison House
htmlContent:
Madison House, a luxury condominium on 15 East 30th Street, is the epicenter of modern urban living in New York City's bustling NoMad neighborhood. Eleonora Srugo, a Manhattan real estate agent, recently showcased this $25 million property to her client Isaac, giving them a glimpse into the lavish lifestyle that awaits within its walls.

A Home Like No Other

This five-bedroom, five-and-a-half-bath condominium, which spans an impressive 5,151 square feet, demonstrates exquisite design and unparalleled craftsmanship. Isaac was immediately drawn to the home's striking features while Justin guided Srugo and Isacc through the residence. Upon entering, the 11-foot ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows gave them panoramic views of the Manhattan skyline, including The Empire State Building and the Hudson River. The natural light that floods every corner of the residence creates an inviting yet sophisticated atmosphere accentuated by the neutral, modern finishes.

Luxury at Every Turn

A state-of-the-art chef's kitchen seamlessly connects to the spacious living and dining area, making it ideal for entertaining. The kitchen blends form and function with custom cabinetry, marble countertops, and top-of-the-line appliances. The five bedrooms offer a private sanctuary, each with sleek, spa-like en-suite bathrooms. This main suite features two walk-in closets and a luxurious bathroom with a deep soaking tub, steam shower, and radiant heated floors.

The Building: Madison House

Madison House is more than just a place to stay; it's a way of life. The building offers unparalleled amenities, including a 75-foot lap pool, a fitness center with a yoga studio, a private spa, and a landscaped rooftop garden with stunning city views.

The Listing Agent: Justin Tuinstra

Justin Tuinstra, who represents some of Manhattan's most prestigious properties, is behind this extraordinary property. Tuinstra emphasized Madison House's unique appeal: ' This condominium offers a rare combination of expansive space, world-class design, and unbeatable location.' It is genuinely one of NoMad's top-tier features. Isaac was clearly impressed by the residence and took in the stunning details as Tuinstra & Srugo gave their expert insights. "Okay, I'm sold," said Isaac. Tuinsta replied, "We should talk numbers."

The Verdict

Isaac is contemplating whether to make this magnificent property his new residence. Still, one thing is certain: Eleonora Srugo and Justin Tuinstra have created an unforgettable experience highlighting the finest properties in New York City's real estate market. This $25 million masterpiece redefines luxury living in a city where every square foot is valuable. If you dream big, Madison House is the ultimate destination.
